listing.name: Persona 3: Dancing in Moonlight — p3d-pc (MaouAnimus) (MaouAnimus)
listing.summary: The project describes rhythm controls and character rendering with 60 Hz timing. A full playthrough has not been established. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own decrypted CUSA12636 dump. This guide does not specify the required update; check the project’s requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the precompiled p3d.exe runtime, or build from source with MSYS2 Clang64 and Ninja. Keep your original game data available.

warnings: The project describes rhythm controls and character rendering with 60 Hz timing. A full playthrough has not been established.
